title: Understanding Foreign Policy and dipolomacy
content:
👋 ሰላም! እንኳን ወደ EthioFresh Global Trends Tutorial በሰላም መጣችሁ! የዚህ ክፍል ዋና አላማ በ Chapter 2 section 2.3 ስር የተካተቱትን የኢትዮጵያ የውጭ ፖሊሲ ታሪካዊ ሂደት (ከአጼ ቴዎድሮስ እስከ ደርግ እና ከ1983/1991 ወዲህ ያለውን የኢህአዴግ/የአሁኑን ዘመን) መስመር በመስመር በጥልቀት በመተንተን ለፈተና 100% ዝግጁ ማድረግ ነው። የትኛውንም አይነት Multiple Choice, Matching ወይም Essay ጥያቄ በበላይነት እንድትመልሱ በታላቅ ቁርጠኝነት የተዘጋጀ ኖት ነው! በርቱ፣ እስከ መጨረሻው አብራችሁን ሁኑ! 👇👇👇

2.3. Overview of Foreign Policy of Ethiopia

Although the Ethiopian state traces its history back to more than 3000 years, the modern imperial state did not begin to emerge until the middle of the 19th century. During the chaotic Era of Princes (Zemene Mesafint), the country was fragmented among regional lords. The process of state formation and centralization began with Emperor Tewodros II and continued through subsequent regimes, heavily influencing Ethiopia's foreign policy behavior, regional interaction, and diplomatic engagement.

👉

የኢትዮጵያ ሀገረ-መንግስት ታሪክ ከ3000 ዓመታት በላይ የሚቆጠር ቢሆንም፣ ዘመናዊው የኢትዮጵያ ማዕከላዊ መንግስት መመስረት የጀመረው በ19ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን እኩሌታ ላይ ነው. በዘመነ መሳፍንት ጊዜ ሀገሪቱ በየአካባቢው ባሉ ሹሞች ተከፋፍላ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ የውጭ ፖሊሲውም የተበታተነ እና የተረጋጋ ማዕከላዊ መዋቅር ያልነበረው ነበር. የዘመናዊቷ ኢትዮጵያ የውጭ ፖሊሲ መሰረት የተጣለው ሀገሪቱን የማዕከላዊ አስተዳደር ባለቤት የማድረግ እና ግዛታዊ አንድነትን የመጠበቅ ጥረት ከተጀመረበት ጊዜ አንስቶ ነው.

2.3.1. Foreign Policy during Tewodros II (1855–1868)

As Ras Kassa emerged as one of the dominant kings by defeating regional lords during the Zemene Mesafint, he was predominantly concerned with establishing control over the fragmented parts of the Empire. Although he only partially succeeded, Tewodros introduced the idea of modernity and a modern army. Throughout his reign, Tewodros tried to develop a dynamic foreign policy reaching beyond the Horn of Africa.

  • Key Foreign Policy Objective: Sought recognition from the Western Christian world and requested assistance to modernize the country. He specifically appealed to Britain, France, and Russia as Christian nations to assist him in his fight against the Turks, Egyptians, and Islam.
  • Use of Religion as Diplomacy: Used Christianity as an instrument of foreign policy to establish diplomatic relations against immediate regional enemies.
  • Technology and Modernization Demand: Tewodros made passionate demands for modern technology and skilled manpower (artisans, gunsmiths) from Britain. However, Britain sent religious missionaries instead, which failed to satisfy his needs.
  • Deterioration & Conflict: Tewodros demanded to be recognized as the Emperor of Ethiopia and treated with respect and equal footing with the British Queen (Queen Victoria). When his letter was not reciprocated, he took desperate measures by taking several British missionaries and the consul hostage. This led to the British Military Expedition under General Napier (Keller). Tewodros's troops were defeated, and he committed suicide at Meqdela without surrendering.
👉

አጼ ቴዎድሮስ ዳግማዊ (ራስ ካሳ) የዘመነ መሳፍንትን ውከት በማስወገድ የተበታተነችዋን ኢትዮጵያ አንድ የማድረግና የማዘመን ራዕይ ነበራቸው.
ዋና የውጭ ፖሊሲ ግቦች እና ስልቶች፦
1️⃣ ክርስትናን እንደ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ መሳሪያ መጠቀም፦ አጼ ቴዎድሮስ የክርስቲያን ምዕራባውያን ሀገራትን (ብሪታንያ፣ ፈረንሳይ እና ሩሲያ) ከግብፅ፣ ቱርክ እና ከእስልምና ሀይሎች የሚሰነዘርባቸውን አደጋ ለመመከት እንደ አጋር ቆጥረዋቸዋል.
2️⃣ የቴክኖሎጂ እና ዘመናዊነት ጥያቄ፦ ከብሪታንያ የፈለጉት የሃይማኖት መስበክ ሳይሆን የጦር መሳሪያ የሚሰሩ እና የሚያድሱ ባለሙያዎችን (Skilled Craftsmen) ነበር. ነገር ግን ብሪታንያ መልስ ባለመስጠቷ እና ሚሲዮናውያንን ብቻ በመላኳ ቅሬታ አደረሰባቸው.
3️⃣ የእኩልነት ጥያቄ እና የመቅደላው ውጊያ፦ አጼ ቴዎድሮስ ከንግስት ቪክቶሪያ ጋር በእኩል ደረጃ መታየት ይፈልጉ ነበር. ደብዳቤያቸው ምላሽ ባለማግኘቱ የብሪታንያ ቆንስላ እና ሚሲዮናውያንን አሰሩ. ይህም በጄኔራል ናፒየር የሚመራው የብሪታንያ የጦር ዘመቻ እንዲመጣ አድርጓል. በስተመጨረሻም አጼ ቴዎድሮስ እጃቸውን ላለመስጠት በመቅደላ እራሳቸውን ሰውተዋል.

😅 EthioFresh Humor Break: አጼ ቴዎድሮስ እኮ ከብሪታንያ የፈለጉት የቴክኖሎጂ አጋርነት እና የጦር መሳሪያ ኤክስፐርት ነበር፤ እነሱ ግን ሚሲዮናዊ ላኩላቸው! ልክ እንደሆነ Freshman ተማሪ Assignment ሲጠይቅ PDF ፋይል ሳይሆን Voice Message እንደመላክ ማለት ነው! 🤦‍♂️
💡 Exam Hint: ፈተና ላይ "Which Ethiopian monarch used Christianity as a core diplomatic tool to solicit Western technology and military support?" ተብሎ ከተጠየቀ መልሱ Emperor Tewodros II ነው! እንዲሁም የናፒየር ዘመቻ (British Military Expedition) ከየትኛው ንጉስ ጋር እንደሚያያዝ አትዘንጉ.

2.3.2. Foreign Policy during Yohannes IV (1872–1889)

Yohannes IV succeeded Tewodros II. Like his predecessor, he perceived foreign Islamic powers as threats to the territorial integrity of the country.

  • Threat Perception: Egypt attempted to invade Ethiopia under various pretexts to control the source of the Blue Nile. Yohannes IV successfully defeated Egyptian armies at the Battle of Gundet (1875) and the Battle of Gura (1876).
  • European Expansionism: Yohannes correctly calculated European expansion as a grave threat. Italy secured a foothold at the Port of Massawa in 1885 following the statement by its Foreign Minister that "The Red Sea is the key to the Mediterranean".
  • Mahdist Conflict and Death: Yohannes IV died fighting the "Mahadists" (Sudanese resistance groups fighting against British rule), who invaded Western Ethiopia due to the presumption that Yohannes was collaborating with the British.
👉

አጼ ዮሐንስ IV የኢትዮጵያን ዳርቻ የመጠበቅ እና የውጭ ወራሪዎችን የመመከት የውጭ ፖሊሲ ነበራቸው.
📌 ዋና ዋና ክስተቶች፦
1️⃣ የግብፅ ወረራ እና ሽንፈት፦ ግብፅ የዓባይን ምንጭ ለመቆጣጠር ያደረገችውን ሙከራ በጉንደት (1875) እና በጉራ (1876) ውጊያዎች አጼ ዮሐንስ ድል አድርገዋቸዋል.
2️⃣ የጣሊያን መስፋፋት፦ ጣሊያን በ1885 ምፅዋን ከተቆጣጠረች በኋላ አጼ ዮሐንስ የአውሮፓውያንን አደጋ ቀድመው ተረድተዋል. የጣሊያን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስተር "ቀይ ባህር የመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ቁልፍ ነው" ብሎ ነበር.
3️⃣ የመሃዲስት ጦርነት፦ ሱዳናውያን (መሃዲስቶች) አጼ ዮሐንስ ከብሪታንያ ጋር አብረዋል በሚል በሰነዘሩት ጥቃት አጼ ዮሐንስ במተማ ጦርነት ህይወታቸውን አጥተዋል.

💡 Exam Hint: ለፈተና Matching ጥያቄ፡ Battle of Gundet (1875) & Gura (1876) -> Defeat of Egyptian Forces by Yohannes IV! 1885 Port of Massawa -> Italian Occupation!

2.3.3. Foreign Policy during Menelik II (1889–1913)

Following the death of Yohannes, Menelik II of Shewa assumed the throne. Prior to his coronation, he expanded his sphere of influence towards the South and East. He recognized the strategic importance of an outlet to the sea, as the northern access had fallen under Italian influence.

  • Double-Track Diplomacy: Menelik used a sophisticated combination of diplomacy and military preparation to contain Italian expansion.
    • Diplomatic Track: Signed treaties, including the famous Wuchale Treaty (1889).
    • Military Track: Prepared by accumulating arms and ammunition from European powers (British, French, and Russia).
  • The Wuchale Treaty Controversy: The treaty failed due to the misinterpretation/manipulation of Article 17.
    • Amharic Version: Stated that Ethiopia could optionally use Italy’s good offices for foreign relations.
    • Italian Version: Made Ethiopia a mandatory protectorate of Italy.
    Menelik abrogated the treaty in 1893 when Italy attempted to enforce the protectorate status.
  • Battle of Adwa (1896): Menelik declared a nationwide war, leading to a decisive Ethiopian victory over Italian colonial forces.
  • Significance of Adwa Outcome:
    • European powers recognized Ethiopia as an independent sovereign African state on equal footing.
    • Britain, France, Russia, and Italy sent formal ambassadors to Menelik's court.
    • Signed formal boundary treaties with surrounding colonial powers (French Somaliland/Djibouti, British Somaliland, Kenya, Italian Somaliland), defining Ethiopia's paper borders.
👉

አጼ ምኒልክ II በጣም ብልህ የሆነ **Double-Track Diplomacy** (ሁለት አቅጣጫዊ ዲፕሎማሲ) ተጠቅመዋል.
📌 ዋና ዋና ነጥቦች፦
1️⃣ የውጫሌ ውል አንቀጽ 17 (Article 17)፦ ጣሊያን በስምምነቱ ማጭበርበር አድርጋ ነበር. በአማርኛው ስሪት ኢትዮጵያ ከሌሎች ሀገራት ጋር ግንኙነት ለማድረግ የጣሊያንን ወዳጅነት መጠቀም *ትችላለች* የሚል ሲሆን፤ በጣሊያንኛው ግን *ግዴታ* በማድረግ ኢትዮጵያን የጣሊያን ጥገኞች (Protectorate) ለማድረግ ሞክረዋል.
2️⃣ የአድዋ ድል (1896)፦ እውነታው ሲጋለጥ አጼ ምኒልክ ውሉን ሰርዘው በ1896 በአድዋ ተራሮች ጣሊያንን በታላቅ የበላይነት አሸነፉ.
3️⃣ ከአድዋ በኋላ፦ አውሮፓውያኑ (ብሪታንያ፣ ፈረንሳይ፣ ሩሲያ፣ ጣሊያን) ኢትዮጵያን እንደ እኩል ነጻ ሀገር አውቀው ኤምባሲዎቻቸውን አዲስ አበባ ከፈቱ፤ ድንበሮችም በውል ተከለሉ. በከፍተኛ ውጥረት ውስጥ ሁነውም ወደቦችን ለመቆጣጠር እንቅስቃሴ ያደርጉ ነበር። እምዬ ምኒልክ ቀና የማለታችን ምክንያት፤ ኩራታችን 👍

💡 Exam Hint: Multiple Choice ጥያቄ፦ "Which Ethiopian leader utilized 'Double-Track Diplomacy' combining military capability accumulation with peace treaties?" -> Emperor Menelik II! እንዲሁም የአንቀጽ 17 ልዩነት በፈተና ላይ በብዛት ይመጣል!

2.3.4. Foreign Policy during Emperor Haile Selassie I (1916–1974)

Regent Teferi Mekonnen (later Emperor Haile Selassie I) pursued active international integration to protect national sovereignty.

  • League of Nations Membership (1923): Facilitated Ethiopia's entry into the League of Nations to gain collective security against Italian threats.
  • Fascist Italian Invasion (1936–1941) & Collective Security Failure: When Fascist Italy invaded, Haile Selassie made a historic plea to the League of Nations in Geneva. The League failed to take effective action, proving the failure of its collective security system. Through effective diplomacy and British strategic necessities during WWII, British military aid helped liberate Ethiopia in 1941.
  • Post-WWII Alignment shift to USA: Fearing British protectorate ambitions after 1941, Haile Selassie loosened ties with Britain and built a strategic alliance with the emerging superpower, the United States.
    • 1953 Agreements: Granted the US rights to the Kagnew Radio Station in Asmara, Eritrea. In return, the US guaranteed security, provided military aid (~$280 million between 1953-1976), and established MAAG (Military Assistance Advisory Group) to train Ethiopian forces.
  • Regional and Global Leadership:
    • Eritrea Question: 1952 UN resolution federated Eritrea with Ethiopia; fully incorporated as a province in 1962.
    • Pan-Africanism: Founding father of the Organization of African Unity (OAU) in 1963, establishing Addis Ababa as the diplomatic capital of Africa. Supported anti-colonialism and anti-apartheid struggles.
    • International Peacekeeping: Committed Ethiopian troops to UN peacekeeping missions in Korea (1951) and the Congo (1961).
    • Good Offices Diplomacy: Resolved internal conflict in Sudan through diplomatic mediation.
👉

አጼ ኃይለሥላሴ ኢትዮጵያን በዓለም አቀፍ መድረክ በጎላ ሁኔታ ያስተዋወቁ እና ዘመናዊ ዲፕሎማሲን የተጠቀሙ መሪ ናቸው.
📌 ዋና ዋና ክስተቶች፦
1️⃣ የመንግስታት ማህበር (League of Nations - 1923)፦ ኢትዮጵያ የጋራ ደህንነትን (Collective Security) ለማረጋገጥ አባል ሆነች. ነገር ግን ጣሊያን በ1928/1936 ስትወር ማህበሩ ኢትዮጵያን ሳይታደግ ቀረ.
2️⃣ ከአሜሪካ ጋር የተደረገ ስትራቴጂካዊ ወዳጅነት (1953)፦ ከብሪታንያ ተፅዕኖ ለመውጣት አጼ ኃይለሥላሴ ከአሜሪካ ጋር የ1953ቱን ስምምነት ተፈራረሙ. አሜሪካ የአስመራውን **ቃኘው ስቴሽን (Kagnew Station)** እንድትጠቀም ተፈቀደላት፤ በምላሹ ለኢትዮጵያ ወታደራዊ እርዳታ፣ ስልጠና (MAAG) እና 280 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ገደማ እርዳታ ሰጠች.
3️⃣ የአፍሪካ አንድነት ድርጅት (OAU) እና ሰላም ማስከበር፦ በ1963 OAU አዲስ አበባ ላይ እንዲመሰረት አደረጉ. በተጨማሪም በኮሪያ (1951) እና በኮንጎ (1961) ሰላም አስከባሪ ጦር ልከዋል.

2.3.5. Foreign Policy during the Military Government / Dergue (1974–1991)

The military regime that took power in 1974 adopted a foreign policy largely oriented towards socialist ideology. Primary objectives were regime survival, maintaining territorial integrity, and restructuring society along socialist lines.

  • Shift in Ideology & Superpower Alliance: Alignment shifted completely from the USA to the USSR (Soviet Union) and the Socialist Bloc (Warsaw Pact, Cuba, East Germany/GDR).
    • Ethio-US relations plummeted due to human rights concerns, resulting in the closure of the US military base/Kagnew station within 72 hours.
    • The USSR, East Germany, and Cuba supplied massive military aid, hardware, technical experts, and advisors.
  • Major External and Domestic Challenges:
    • Domestic Rebellion: Eritrean Liberation Front (ELF) backed by external actors including Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Sudan, Somalia, and later the US.
    • External Aggression: Somalia’s invasion of Ogaden (1977/78).
  • Cold War Realignment in the Horn: The USSR made a swift policy change by switching support from Somalia to Ethiopia, while the USA backed Somalia. With Soviet arms and Cuban troops, the Dergue reversed Somali aggression.
  • Regional Dynamics: Strained relations with Sudan due to cross-border opposition support (Ethiopia supported SPLA/Spire; Sudan supported Ethiopian rebels). Relations with Arab countries remained mistrustful.
  • Demise: When the Cold War ended and the USSR/Socialist bloc collapsed, the withdrawal of military/financial aid directly hastened the collapse of the military regime in 1991.

2.3.6. The Foreign Policy of Ethiopia in the Post 1991 Period

With EPRDF's ascent to power in 1991, Ethiopia adopted a new foreign policy orientation centered on national interest, democratic governance, and economic development.

  • Core Driving Philosophy - "Inside-Out" Approach:
    • Prioritizes solving domestic political, governance, and economic problems first before external issues.
    • Belief that internal vulnerability (poverty, lack of democracy, instability) invites external threats and exploitation by foreign enemies.
    • Internal strength creates external security and deterrence.
  • Economic Diplomacy: Foreign policy serves as an instrument to achieve rapid economic development and eliminate poverty.
    • Focuses on attracting Foreign Direct Investment (FDI), seeking foreign markets for Ethiopian exports, securing technical aid/loans, and exploiting opportunities of globalization.
  • "East-Look Policy": Learning from the rapid development successes of East Asian countries such as Singapore, Malaysia, and Indonesia.
  • Deterrence and Military Modernization: Peaceful dialogue and negotiations are prioritized for dispute settlement, but building a modernized, capable national military acts as a vital deterrence strategy.
  • Summary of Policy Objectives Across Regimes:
    Regime / EraPrimary Focus / ApproachKey Partners
    Imperial Era (Tewodros, Yohannes, Menelik, Haile Selassie)Territorial integrity, state survival, anti-colonialism, collective securityBritain, France, USA
    Military Regime (Dergue)Socialist transformation, regime survival, heavy militarizationUSSR, Cuba, Eastern Bloc
    Post-1991 Regime"Inside-Out" approach, Economic Diplomacy, democracy, poverty reductionEmerging East Asian states, Western financial institutions, neighbors

2️⃣ Economic Diplomacy (ኢኮኖሚያዊ ዲፕሎማሲ)፦ የውጭ ፖሊሲው ዋና አላማ ሀገሪቱን ከድህነት ማውጣት፣ የውጭ ኢንቨስትመንት (FDI) መሳብ እና ለሀገር ውስጥ ምርቶች የውጭ ገበያ መፈለግ ነው.
3️⃣ East-Look Policy፦ እንደ ሲንጋፖር፣ ማሌዥያ እና ኢንዶኔዢያ ካሉ የእስያ ሀገራት የኢኮኖሚ እድገት ተሞክሮ መውሰድ.
